Check 3 pending for any election-night posting not listed now.
tag_rationale: All three elections are LATER by check 2 (summaries on election night; precinct reports only later or not online), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; no printed run time is readable, so confidence is low.
